detail.longDescription: 🦏 NEW: A rare greater one-horned # rhinoceros was born at # England ’s # Chester # Zoo , with surveillance cameras capturing the # birth and the calf’s early steps. # Conservation scientists monitored the mother’s # pregnancy through behavioral observations and fecal hormone testing, contributing to an international # breeding program designed to maintain genetic diversity for threatened # species . 👉 https://www. popsci.com/environment/baby-rh ino-birth-video-chester-zoo-england/ # animals # science # biology # wildlife # research # nature # education # mammals # endangered # ecology # uk
